excepted.justification: Exact TCP port-80 ingress belongs exclusively to public load balancers whose HTTP listeners redirect to HTTPS.
Public ALB listeners use HTTPS with optional redirect-only HTTP; public NLB listeners use only explicit TLS 1.2+ policies.
